name: Taki Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the chemicals, water treatment, and functional materials businesses in Japan. The company operates through Agriculture, Chemicals, Building Materials, Oil, Real estate, and Transportation segments. It provides water treatment chemicals, including polyaluminum chloride for drinking and industrial water treatment, urban sewage treatment, effluent treatment from civil engineering works, industrial wastewater treatment, coagulation in production process, and organic sludge filtration and dehydration. The company also offers functional chemical materials, such as water-soluble aluminum compounds, including takiceram, aluminum phosphate-based binders, and takibin…
